newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian cabinet to discuss law ending Savoy exile.
newsitem.headline: Italian cabinet to discuss law ending Savoy exile.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi's cabinet will meet on Friday at 0730 GMT, his office said on Wednesday.

One of the measures the cabinet will discuss is a draft law that would, if approved later by parliament, allow the son of Italy's last king and his male heirs to return home after a half century in exile.

Male heirs of the Savoy family, which ruled Italy from 1861 to 1946, are banned by the country's post-war republican constitution from returning. Vittorio Emanuele, the son of Italy's last king, has been living in Switzerland.
Prodi announced earlier this month that he would propose the change in the constitution.
